label: Thin epistemic reason existence: Existence of some agent and content related by Reason: some agent…
definition: Existence of some agent and content related by Reason: some agent has an epistemic reason to believe some content. The Lean existential does not constrain the interpretation of Reason through correctness, evidence, desires, causal influence or authority.
note: Names the formal scope already encoded by accepted F6, without changing its intended meaning, recorded approval or declaration. It is not a replacement definition of epistemic reasons as arbitrary relations. See docs/notes/epistemic-reasons-preconditions.md.
